sentence_stem: Of all the mountains we climbed,
full_sentence: Of all the mountains we climbed, this one was the highest.
acceptable_variants: this one was the most challenging.
this one had the best view.

options.text: we were very tired at the end.
options.why_wrong: This describes how we felt, but it does not complete the comparison that 'of all' introduces.

options.text: we took a lot of photos.
options.why_wrong: This describes an activity and does not compare the mountains, so it does not fit the 'of all' structure.

options.text: we had a picnic at the top.
options.why_wrong: This describes an event at one place and does not compare the mountains with each other.

explanation: After 'of all', we need a superlative that compares the mountains. The structure is 'of all + group + the + superlative adjective'.
translation: Tırmandığımız tüm dağlar arasında bu, en yüksek olanıydı.
